The probe behind D-321 evaluated BOTH SIDES at every ply at a fixed `StonesLeft::Two` and `HitBudget::Two`; its own `side-positions = 3406 = 2 × 1703` is the tell. So roughly half its population was a side not to move, and its phase-`Second` entries were queried at the wrong stones-left and the wrong budget. THE CORRECTED FIGURES, MEASURED over the same seeded playout regime with the protocol's own predicate, instrument reproduced verbatim in `docs/experiments/matrix_M3_selection.md`: **1700 mover positions evaluated, 174 FILTERED, 22 where the two conventions give different unions — 12.6 %.** The `pop()`-mutant rates move with it: **S-K 132 of 154 (85.7 %)**, S-M 154 of 154 (100.0 %). D-321's CONCLUSION IS UNCHANGED AND ITS DIRECTION SURVIVES — the question is live and not vestigial, 12.6 % of the nodes the gate will actually visit — and every other clause of D-321 stands: the calculus is not amended, `inclusion` still occurs zero times in it, `DEF-T` still fixes a cardinality, and the DEPENDS-OPEN-THEORY mark still binds. WHAT THIS LINE IS FOR, beyond the arithmetic: the figure was wrong in BOTH directions — it inflated the number used rhetorically (28.0 % against 12.6 %) and deflated the number used against the author's own recommendation (72.0 % against 85.7 %) — so this is an ATTRIBUTION defect and not a bias, and attribution is precisely what CLAUDE.md's dry-run clause says a synthetic check cannot catch. It reached an append-only log inside one commit of being measured, which is the argument for the rule the same round adopted: a registered number carries its instrument, and its instrument carries a revision. Flips never; this line is the correction. A later measurement over a different regime is a new line about a new population.

D-323: **MATRIX M3 SELECTS S-M — THE DIFFERENTIAL GATE ASSERTS PER-NODE EQUALITY OF THE EMITTED SET AGAINST THE LANDED REFERENT R1, REUSED AND NOT REWRITTEN — AND THE MATRIX'S OWN RECOMMENDATION IS NOT WHAT WAS SELECTED.** Field: `docs/experiments/matrix_M3_soundness_instrument_rev2.md` at `d48824f`, thirteen rows, authored under R8 by a session that did not author revision 1. Attack: `docs/experiments/matrix_M3_REDTEAM_round2.md` at `809b5db`. Selection record, with the five registered conditions in full: `docs/experiments/matrix_M3_selection.md`. THE RECOMMENDED ROW, S-K, IS DEAD, and it died on measurement rather than on argument: U4 §8.4 registers exactly two mutations of the differential gate's class, and **S-K fires on NEITHER** — M4 survives it on M4's own pinned legally-reachable witness, M3 survives it on 20 of 20 differing nodes of the registered regime — while S-M kills both. An instrument for a gate that fires on none of that gate's registered mutations is the vacuity that killed S-C one round earlier. THE STRONGEST ATTACK SURVIVING AGAINST S-M, quoted from the red team because CLAUDE.md wants the surviving attack and not a paraphrase: *"S-M asserts the convention D-321 records as OPEN: if the project settles toward `DEF-T`'s minimum-cardinality reading, the gate turns RED on a correct engine, and its referent cannot warn of it — R1 is independent of `cover.rs`'s CODE and shares its CONVENTION, so fact 7's `0 of 3406` agreement is invariant under precisely the defect in question, which is CLAUDE.md's two-instruments-blind-to-the-same-stage clause read from inside."* R8 does not exclude S-M, because R8 bars a DEPENDS-OPEN-THEORY row from beating an immune row ON THE CONVENTION GROUND and S-M's measured advantage is on a different ground — M3 is a phase-regeneration defect, not a convention — and because F4 measured S-K's own IMMUNE mark to be unearned: `DEF-T` fixes a NUMBER and S-K asserts a SET, on a step S-K's own cell concedes is not entailed, live on 116 of 174 (66.7 %) of the protocol's FILTERED nodes. FIVE CONDITIONS RIDE WITH THE SELECTION and each is a red-team finding that would otherwise ride free: (1) R1 is REUSED by `#[path]` include — MEASURED to compile and answer from the consuming crate's test tree — and a second freshly-written referent for this criterion is FORBIDDEN without a registered agreement criterion and a registered consequence for disagreement; (2) the `0 of 3406` agreement MAY NOT be cited as evidence about the convention, because both instruments are blind to it together; (3) the gate ships MARKED DEPENDS-OPEN-THEORY under D-321; (4) the rules-derived row **S-N** the red team found missing is OWED and is a FLIP TRIGGER, not a footnote; (5) the registered numbers carry their instrument, whose source is committed in the selection record. THE FIELD WAS INCOMPLETE AND THIS SELECTED ANYWAY, which is the opposite disposition to D-318's and the record says why: there the missing row DOMINATED the recommendation on its own trigger, here the missing row dominates only the row that is already dead, is not costed against the survivor, has no stated criterion — the red team says so in its own words — and is RED on a correct engine in its only written form, at a MEASURED 1.76 M legal turns per FILTERED node. Flips if S-N is stated in a form that is green on a correct engine and affordable at a sampled population, at which point M3 reopens as a two-row comparison; or if the convention is settled toward `DEF-T`, at which point this gate is RED on a correct engine and the criterion is re-derived rather than the engine changed.

D-324: **MATRIX M4 IS STOPPED AFTER A THIRD AUTHORED REVISION AND A THIRD FRESH-CONTEXT DECISION-RED-TEAM, WITH NOTHING SELECTED — AND THIS STOP IS THE RECORDED TIE, WHOSE CAUSE IS THAT THE FIELD HAS TWO ORTHOGONAL AXES AND HAS BEEN SCORED AS ONE.** Revision 3 is `docs/experiments/matrix_M4_snapshot_config_seam_rev3.md` at `9ce863f`, authored under R9 by a session that authored neither prior revision; its attack is `docs/experiments/matrix_M4_REDTEAM_round3.md`; the stop record with the tie stated in full is `docs/experiments/matrix_M4_stop_round3.md`. It is NOT the every-option-fell stop — N-E, N-J, N-K, N-F and N-L all survive. THE CAUSE, which is the round's real finding and which three revisions of argument were unknowingly about: **AXIS A is how the config is NAMED** (N-A′, N-E, N-M, N-N, N-Q, N-G, N-L) and **AXIS B is how many RECORDS one invocation produces** (N-K against all the rest). N-K is not a rival of the naming rows and composes with one of them — the red team's own words, that N-K *"owes on its second config exactly the caller-named-path obligation N-E owes on its first"* — so a matrix listing a two-record MODE beside three naming MECHANISMS has rows that are not alternatives, which is why every round found its recommendation resting on a ground that argues equally for four or five rows. THE TIE ON AXIS A: the one differential ground revision 3 offered, the guard surface, is MEASURED AWAY — D-232's newline line-injection class is already refused on the config path by `digest()`'s hex-shape check, reproduced at exit 1 with a named refusal, and the residue (TAB, ESC, U+2028) closes with THREE LINES copying the guard at `tools/baseline_snapshot.sh:289` — leaving a judgement rather than a measurement: whether a token→path map in a script satisfies hard rule 1's MECHANISM as well as its VOCABULARY, given that `Budget` is a closed enum of KINDS whose values live in the schema while N-M is a closed enum of VALUES living in the script. Nothing this session can identify separates N-E from N-M from N-Q by measurement. **AXIS B IS DIFFERENT AND ITS FLIP CLAUSE HAS FIRED:** revision 3 declined to recommend N-K solely because its cost was unmeasured for a third revision, and registered the clause *"The measurement of N-K's cost is taken and is small. Remedy: flip to N-K"* BEFORE the measurement; the red team then measured it at **8 added lines, 0 removed, no re-indentation, two complete records at two policies from one invocation, ~2× wall (2 × 33 s on the registered corpus)**. The clause fires, and it settles axis B only. THE FIELD IS INCOMPLETE FOR A THIRD REVISION: N-Q — `--config PATH` refused unless it resolves under `configs/` — is absent from all three revisions and all three attacks, dominates N-M on N-M's own failure mode and N-E on guard surface, and is `tools/SHELL_CHECKLIST.md` ITEM 11 under this project's own name, in a round bound to that checklist that answered no item of it by name. AND THE AUTHOR'S OWN MEASUREMENT RECORD IS PART OF THIS LINE, first-person, because D-318 already ruled that the recurrence and not the instance is the finding: **the pattern recurred in the revision written to break it, and this session is the author.** Fact 4's "verbatim output" was truncated by one line — `tools/bench_delta.sh:120`, a site in scope by fact 4's own definition — which under R7 kills the only MEASURED support in the recommended row's cost cell; fact 1's READING was false, `engine_id config` being `format!("config {}", path.display())`, the argument echoed back, so the record is attested TWO ways and not three and ground 1 loses its fact cell; fact 7's paste was elided toward the thesis; and the row this session added on its own measurement, N-P, falls with its vacuous-criterion defence. Both decisive findings were RE-RUN by this session against its own text before this line was written. That is three distinct authoring sessions producing this pattern in one work package. WHAT IS BLOCKED, unchanged from D-318: no config seam, so no Staged snapshot, the registered above-marker quantity has a BEFORE and no AFTER, U4-Z item 15 stays blocked and B2 stays open — and independently, the AFTER is blocked on `configs/instrument_staged_v0.toml`, which does not exist and which no row produces. TWO SHIPPED-INSTRUMENT DEFECTS found in passing and owned by no row are recorded in the stop record and are OPEN: a SPACE in a caller-named `--corpus` path reaches the record unescaped at exit 0 under the COMPLETE token, breaking the record's own leading-tokens parse rule; and `crates/pistol-cli/src/report.rs:151-162` rewrites control characters to `?` in the engine's handshake while the script writes its copy raw, so one record's two config lines can disagree for a reason unrelated to the config. Flips when the architect selects on the recorded tie — N-K on axis B plus one of {N-E with three guard lines, N-M, N-Q} on axis A — or orders a fourth round scoped to axis A alone with N-Q authored into it, at which point this line is superseded rather than amended.

D-325: **D-316's DIAGNOSIS OF ITS OWN MEASURED CORRECTION IS FALSE AND IS CORRECTED HERE — THE COST CELL DID NOT COUNT "ONLY THE SITES OUTSIDE THE UNIT"; IT COUNTED ONE INSIDE SITE AND MISSED THREE OTHERS. THE COUNT SIX STANDS.** Found by the fresh-context REVIEW-design of U4 (`docs/experiments/wp15b_U4_REVIEW.md`, MINOR 8) and VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY before this line was written. D-316 says: *"the cell counted only the sites outside the unit and missed three inside it (U4's head B4 sentence, its U4-A lineage row, its U4-Z lead-in)"*. The cell it describes is quoted in `docs/experiments/U4_soundness_instrument.md` at u-rev 6, lines 1160-1161: *"**three** cross-references outside §8 retarget — `configs/tactical_staged_v0.toml`'s 'why' cell and §10's B5 paragraph, both **U3** §10, **and item 15 in this unit's list**, which says 'gate (a)'."* Item 15 is inside the unit and is site 3 of the correction table, so the cell counted an inside site and the diagnosis is wrong about what it counted. WHAT IS UNCHANGED: the CORRECTION ITSELF. Six sites retarget and not three; the reviewer enumerated them and confirmed there is no seventh; and D-316's conclusion — that the correction errs toward the selected option and does not move the selection, because the cell's own closing sentence is that the count is not the argument — stands untouched. WHY A LINE RATHER THAN AN EDIT: the log is append-only and rule 10 says a decision that changes is superseded by a new line naming the one it replaces, never edited in place. WHY THE LINE IS WORTH ITS SPACE, since only an explanation is wrong: the paragraph the false sentence sits in is ABOUT THE ACCURACY OF COST CELLS — it is the paragraph that corrects one — and a mis-diagnosis of how a cell went wrong is how the next cell goes wrong the same way. U4's own copy of the sentence is repaired at u-rev 6 (`7358a07`); this line repairs the log's. Flips never; this line is the correction, and D-316's selection, its residual and its flip clause are all unaffected.

D-326: **D-312 IS AMENDED — IT NAMES THE WRONG REFERENT FOR THE RENAMED CENSUS GATE. THE GATE RESOLVES ITS DOCUMENTS THROUGH `CARVE_DOCS`, A HARD-CODED CONSTANT LIST; `CARVE_MARKER` IS THE INDEPENDENT REFERENT A DIFFERENT, THIRD GATE COMPARES THAT CONSTANT AGAINST.** D-312 says the renamed gate `the_carved_design_units_carry_this_censuss_table_verbatim` *"now resolves its documents through the `CARVE_MARKER` line each carved file carries"*. It does not. **MEASURED at `d85b049` in `crates/pistol-solver/tests/wp15b_census.rs`:** `grep -n "carve_documents()"` → the helper is defined at `:666` and called at `:740` and `:801`, which are the bodies of `the_carved_design_units_carry_this_censuss_table_verbatim` (`:738`) and `the_census_pin_reads_every_carved_document_it_names` (`:799`); the helper's own doc comment at `:665` reads *"Read every document in `CARVE_DOCS`, refusing by name rather than skipping"* and its body iterates `CARVE_DOCS` (`:667`), the six-entry constant at `:645`. `grep -n "CARVE_MARKER"` → four hits, of which the only executable one is `:859`, inside `the_pins_document_list_is_the_set_of_carved_documents_on_disk` (`:851`). **SO BOTH CONTENT GATES READ THE CONSTANT AND NEITHER READS THE TREE**, and the marker's entire job is to give the THIRD gate a referent the constant does not share. **WHY THIS IS WORTH A LINE AND NOT A SHRUG:** D-312's own argument for the rename is that the old gate *"would have gone GREEN over a file it no longer read, which is `tools/SHELL_CHECKLIST.md`'s EXIT-0-WRONG-ANSWER wearing a Rust test's name"*, and the sentence corrected here credits the content gate with exactly the tree-derived resolution that would immunise it against that class. It has no such immunity — the code says so at `:640-644`, in a comment written against this very hazard: *"a coverage test that iterates this constant passes on a list of one — MEASURED: it did"*. A reader taking D-312 at its word would believe the pin cannot drift out from under the carve, when what prevents that drift is the third gate and only the third gate. This is the code-and-log-disagree case rule 10 names, and here the LOG is the wrong one. **WHAT IS UNCHANGED:** every other clause of D-312 stands — the rename happened, it is travelling item T4′, the two further gates land as described and do the jobs described, and D-304's residual is still not narrowed. The three-gate ARRANGEMENT is correct as built; only D-312's account of which gate reads what is wrong. Nothing in the tree changes under this line; it is the text that is tightened to the code's actual referent. Flips never; this line is the correction. If the content gates are ever rewritten to resolve through `CARVE_MARKER` directly, that is a new line about a new arrangement, and the independence the third gate supplies would have to be re-argued rather than inherited.

D-327: **ARCHITECT RULING R13, RECORDED — A GATE OR TEST CLAIM CITES `tools/ci.sh`'s OWN LOG OUTPUT AND NEVER A WRAPPER'S EXIT STATUS, AND A GATE TABLE THAT DOES NOT COVER EVERY GATE IS LABELLED `PARTIAL` ON ITS FACE.** This is CLAUDE.md's existing Workflow sentence (*"A gate or test claim in any report cites the gate's own log output, never a wrapper's exit status"*) given the second half it was missing: the first half stops a report from laundering an exit code, and the second stops a report from laundering COVERAGE. A table listing four gates green, in a run of fourteen, is true of what it lists and false as an answer to *"do the gates pass"*; unlabelled, it is read as the latter. **THE INSTANCE, MEASURED at `da5daa1`:** `crates/pistol-solver/tests/wp15b_mutation_witnesses.rs` landed unformatted at `dab170b`, so gate 1 of 14 — `cargo fmt --all --check` — was RED from that commit until `5518eac` repaired it. `git rev-list --count dab170b~1..5518eac~1` → **15**: fifteen commits were authored and landed with the formatting gate failing, and the commit message of the repair records that one of those revisions was *"handed as all-gates-green"* to a session that then built on it. No wrapper lied and no exit status was faked; the claim was simply never checked against the gate's own output, for fifteen commits. **WHAT THE RULING BINDS:** (1) a report asserting any gate result quotes the line `tools/ci.sh` itself printed for that gate, not a summary of it and not the script's exit code; (2) a table or list covering fewer than all of the gates carries the word `PARTIAL` in its own heading, together with which gates it omits; (3) "all gates pass" is claimable only from a run of the whole of `tools/ci.sh`, whose final line is `ci: all gates passed`. **WHAT IT DOES NOT DO:** it does not make a PARTIAL table a breach — a proportionate check of one gate is often the right check — it makes an UNLABELLED one a breach, because the defect is the reader's inference and not the author's run. A RECORDED SECOND INSTANCE, found while writing this line and left in rather than tidied away: the dispatch that ordered this ruling cited its own instance as `4a23673`, and `git cat-file -t 4a23673` returns *"Not a valid object name"* — the SHA resolves to nothing in this repository, and the fmt instance it meant is `5518eac`. A cited revision nobody resolves is the same defect one level up from a cited gate nobody re-reads. Flips if `tools/ci.sh` ceases to be the single definition of the gate set, at which point "the gate's own log" needs a new referent and this line is amended rather than reinterpreted.

D-328: **ARCHITECT RULING R11, RECORDED AND STANDING — THE SESSION THAT AUTHORS AN OPTION MATRIX DOES NOT PRODUCE ITS OWN MEASURED CELLS. A SEPARATE MEASURER RUNS EVERY REGISTERED COMMAND AND RETURNS ITS LOGS, AND THE AUTHOR CITES THEM.** The Process section already requires every numeric claim in a matrix to be marked MEASURED or ESTIMATED, and already calls an estimate that could have been measured in seconds a finding (D-291). R11 answers the failure that survived both: cells correctly MARKED `MEASURED` whose commands, re-run, return something else. **THE GROUND IS A MEASURED RECURRENCE ACROSS THREE CONSECUTIVE AUTHORING SESSIONS OF ONE WORK PACKAGE, and the recurrence rather than any instance is what this line rests on** — D-318 said exactly that and was then followed by two more. (1) **D-318**: three MEASURED cells that did not reproduce, all favouring their author's recommendation. (2) **D-322**: D-321's `84 of 300 / 28.0 %` corrected to `22 of 174 / 12.6 %`, because the probe evaluated both sides at a fixed `StonesLeft::Two` where the protocol specifies the mover at the phase-derived value — an ATTRIBUTION defect, wrong in BOTH directions (it inflated the figure used rhetorically and deflated the one that told against its author), which is why bias is not the diagnosis and self-measurement is. (3) **D-324**: in the revision written to break the pattern, fact 4's "verbatim output" was short by the one line that named the shipped script, fact 1's reading of `engine_id config` was false because the field is `format!("config {}", path.display())` — the argument echoed back, not an independent attestation — fact 7's paste was elided toward its thesis, and the row that session added on its own measurement fell with them. **WHY A SPLIT AND NOT MORE CARE:** every one of these was authored by a session that wanted a particular row to win, and each defect moved its cell toward that row; the author is not a neutral reader of a command whose output decides the author's recommendation. The split does not require a better measurer, only a different one, and it is cheap here because the workloads are seconds. **WHAT THE RULING BINDS:** (1) the author of a matrix revision writes the GROUNDS, the options, the failure modes and the flip clauses, and writes no MEASURED cell from a command it ran itself; (2) a measurer with no stake in the recommendation runs every registered command and returns its COMPLETE output, not a summary; (3) the matrix cites those logs, and a cell whose log does not appear is not MEASURED; (4) this composes with, and does not replace, the fresh-context DECISION-RED-TEAM, which attacks the matrix after the cells are in it. **WHAT IT DOES NOT DO:** it does not apply to a red team, whose whole job is to re-run the author's commands against the author's text, and it does not license an unattacked matrix on the ground that its numbers came from elsewhere. Flips if a split round nonetheless ships a MEASURED cell that does not reproduce, at which point the diagnosis was wrong — the defect is not self-measurement — and this line is superseded by the round that finds it.

D-329: **MATRIX M4'S AXIS A SELECTS N-E — A REQUIRED `--config PATH` WITH NO DEFAULT AND A NEW WHOLE-PATH GUARD — AT TIEBREAK RUNG (b), AFTER N-M IS ELIMINATED ON REGISTERED GROUND AND RUNG (a) IS FOUND SILENT. THE MATRIX RECOMMENDED N-Q AND ITS OWN RED TEAM KILLED THAT RECOMMENDATION.** Field: `docs/experiments/matrix_M4_axisA_round4.md` at `7866bcf`, the fourth round D-324's stop clause authorised, scoped to axis A alone with N-Q authored into it, every MEASURED cell produced by a separate measurement agent under D-328. Attack: `docs/experiments/matrix_M4_axisA_REDTEAM.md`, thirteen findings, nine of ten facts reproducing. Selection record with the ladder run in full: `docs/experiments/matrix_M4_axisA_selection.md`. **AXIS B IS NOT REOPENED** — D-324 records its flip clause already fired toward N-K, and N-K composes with the naming mechanism selected here rather than rivalling it. **THE ELIMINATION COMES FIRST AND IS NOT A TIEBREAK:** red-team F10, MEASURED — `docs/experiments/wp15b_sprt_prereg.md` §7A.2 registers the invocation `tools/baseline_snapshot.sh --config configs/gate_v0.toml` and §10 registers that document's flip *"if `tools/baseline_snapshot.sh` lands `--config` in a shape the §7A.2 criterion cannot be taken under"*; N-E and N-Q take that invocation at exit 0 and N-M refuses it at exit 1, so N-M lands the flag in precisely the barred shape, in a pre-registration whose §11 records it has never passed a review. **RUNG (a) IS SILENT ACROSS THE FIELD**, and this is where the matrix went wrong: hard rule 1's fourth clause governs DEFAULTS — *"NO code-side default for any tunable — a default lives in exactly one schema place"* — and MEASURED, none of the three rows has a default, all refusing an absent `--config` by name at exit 1; the round-3 red team had already ruled that clause *"a WOUND, not a KILL"* for that reason; and `configs/` is not one schema, holding four engine configs, six arena match configs and a weights table with the engine exiting 2 on two of three sampled. **RUNG (b) THEN SELECTS N-E** on cells the attacker re-derived exactly: 22 added / 7 CODE against N-Q's 32 / 12, with both owing the same 4 whole-path guard lines and N-Q owing 5 containment lines on top; rung (c) is not reached. THREE MEASURED FINDINGS MAKE RUNG (b)'s ANSWER RIGHT ON SUBSTANCE AND NOT ONLY CHEAP: N-Q's selling property is false — `.gitignore`'s `*.bin` makes `configs/ghost_v0.bin` invisible to git, and it passes containment into the invariant block at exit 0 beside a revision no commit ties it to, so containment bounds by DIRECTORY and never by COMMIT; N-Q is the only row that ADDS a defect — `ROOT` is bash's logical `pwd` against `realpath -m`'s physical, so through a symlinked checkout N-Q refuses the repository's own `configs/instrument_v0.toml` while N-E completes, a void reported as a fail; and N-Q's extra lines are required by no rule here, since item 11's scope is a binding consumed by `rm`, `mv` or a write and item 9 is discharged by the guard both rows owe. **THE STRONGEST SURVIVING ATTACK AGAINST N-E IS ASSEMBLED AND NOT QUOTED, AND THAT IS RECORDED AS A RESIDUAL** — the red team was dispatched to break N-Q, recommends N-E, and was never asked to break it: *"N-E is selected because it is the cheapest row that adds no defect — not because it delivers what the record's `config` line exists for … N-E bounds the admissible set nowhere, so a record may name a document outside the repository that no other reader can obtain … the round measured that the one row which tried to fix this does not fix it either, so the weakness is not resolved by this selection, only left where it was."* **FOUR CONDITIONS RIDE WITH THE SELECTION:** (1) the `config` line's digest is `$3` and not `$4` — that line is `config <path> <sha>`, three fields, and the four-token reasoning belongs to the differently shaped `corpus` line; (2) N-E's guard may NOT be spelled as a reuse of the basename loop, measured twice as leaving the digest displaced at exit 0 under the COMPLETE kind token; (3) an item-10 driving test is owed for both new refusal classes in two halves with a control, against a precedent of 91 test lines for one arm at `b067d47`, and no row in this round was costed for it; (4) an item-12 sentence is owed saying a config refusal is a FAIL, this script having declared no void class. **WHAT THIS SUPERSEDES:** D-324's *"closed by THREE LINES copying the guard already at `tools/baseline_snapshot.sh:289`"* is wrong in count (four at `b067d47`) and wrong in kind (the loop guards a basename, the record writes a whole path), and D-324's framing of the missing `configs/instrument_staged_v0.toml` as an N-M cost is corrected — it blocks all three rows equally. Flips if N-E's whole-path guard cannot be written to admit the registered `configs/gate_v0.toml` invocation while refusing the injection classes, at which point the field is re-opened with the guard's shape as the decision; or if a containment requirement is imposed on read bindings by a rule this tree does not yet carry, at which point N-Q returns with F5's logical/physical mismatch owed as a fix.

D-330: **D-328's FLIP CLAUSE FIRED ON THE FIRST ROUND IT GOVERNED, AND THE DIAGNOSIS IS AMENDED RATHER THAN WITHDRAWN: THE AUTHOR/MEASURER SPLIT IS NECESSARY AND NOT SUFFICIENT, BECAUSE IT SEPARATES A MEASURER FROM THE RECOMMENDATION AND NOT FROM AN ATTRIBUTION ERROR.** D-328 registered *"Flips if a split round nonetheless ships a MEASURED cell that does not reproduce, at which point the diagnosis was wrong — the defect is not self-measurement — and this line is superseded by the round that finds it."* **IT FIRED IMMEDIATELY.** `docs/experiments/matrix_M4_axisA_round4.md` was the first matrix authored under the split — this author wrote no MEASURED cell, a separate agent ran every command — and its FACT 5, the round's own headline, pasted *"4th token a reader would take as the digest: dir/instrument_v0.toml"*. **MEASURED at `7e0a328`, and verified by this session before the finding was landed:** `printf 'config configs/instrument_v0.toml <sha>\n' | awk '{print NF}'` → **3**. The `config` line is `config <path> <sha>`, three fields, and its digest is `$3`. With a space in the path the line has four fields and `$4` IS the digest, `$3` being the displaced `dir/instrument_v0.toml`. So the pasted value is `$3`'s under a label naming `$4`. The four-token reasoning is the **`corpus`** line's — `corpus <name> sha256 <hex> positions N` — where it is correct and where `b067d47`'s commit message states it correctly; the probe carried it across to a line of a different shape. **WHAT THE FLIP DOES AND DOES NOT DO.** It does NOT withdraw the split: D-318, D-322 and D-324 recorded three sessions whose non-reproducing cells each moved toward their author's recommendation, and nothing here touches that finding or the remedy for it — FACT 5's error is direction-neutral, favouring no row, which is precisely the signature of an attribution slip rather than a motivated one. What it kills is the SUFFICIENCY claim D-328's framing invited. A measurer with no stake cannot produce a motivated number; it can produce a wrong one, and a wrong one reaches an ADR just as fast. **WHAT ACTUALLY CAUGHT IT is the third mechanism, and it is the one to strengthen: a fresh-context adversary RE-RUNNING the inline evidence (R7).** The red team reproduced nine facts and broke the tenth; neither the author nor the measurer could have caught this one, because both were reading the same mislabelled probe. **SO THE AMENDED RULE IS THREE-PART, not two:** (1) the author writes grounds and no MEASURED cell of its own; (2) a measurer with no stake runs every registered command and returns COMPLETE output; (3) **the attacker re-runs the inline evidence rather than reading it, and a fact whose pasted output it cannot reproduce is a finding against the round even when the fact's conclusion survives** — which is exactly what happened here, FACT 5's conclusion standing while its evidence line did not. AND ONE CONCRETE OPERATIONAL LESSON, worth more than the general one: **a field index is not portable between record lines of different shapes**, and this project now has two lines that differ by exactly one field. Any probe that reads a record by position states which line it is reading and re-derives the index for that line. **THAT IS FOUR CONSECUTIVE INSTANCES** of D-318's pattern in one work package, and the fourth is the first that a split was in place to prevent — so the pattern's cause is now measured to be wider than the split's reach. Flips if a round running all three parts still ships a non-reproducing MEASURED cell, at which point the remedy is not a process rule at all and the honest response is to stop registering numbers this way.

D-331: **ARCHITECT RULING R15, SETTLED AND STANDING — THE CLAIM-HOME LAW. EVERY CLAIM HAS EXACTLY ONE HOME SECTION. EVERY OTHER OCCURRENCE OF IT IS A POINTER — A SECTION REFERENCE, A FILE REFERENCE OR AN ADR REFERENCE — AND NEVER A RESTATEMENT.** **THE GROUND IS A MEASURED RECURRENCE ACROSS THREE CONSECUTIVE REPAIR SESSIONS OF ONE WORK PACKAGE, and the recurrence rather than any instance is what this line rests on**, which is the same footing D-328 stands on and the same footing D-305 named. (1) **U4 u-rev 6** shipped U4-Z carrying the pre-D-320 state of B3's residual while D-320 had landed in the very commit whose D-321 the same u-rev folded — BLOCKING 1 of `docs/experiments/wp15b_U4_REVIEW_urev6.md`. (2) **U4 u-rev 7** answered that by RE-DERIVING U4-Z in full rather than patching it, and the re-derivation itself turned up a SECOND landed line the unit was contradicting that no finding had named (D-325). (3) **U4 u-rev 7's re-review found THREE MORE, inside the section rewritten in full to prevent them** (`docs/experiments/wp15b_U4_REVIEW_urev7.md`, MAJOR 2, 3 and 4): the SHELL_CHECKLIST engagement set stated as *"eight of twelve … plus D-329's four conditions on top"* when D-329 REMOVES item 11 and U4's own §9 says so; the relative-base residual attributed to *"recorded by D-329"* when D-329 records nothing of the kind and the selection record records it as condition 4; and travelling item T2 declared *"named in no document now in the tree"* when two tree documents name it on the same line from which the unit resolves its sibling T5. The falsifying line in the first of those three is **D-329 — the ADR line that same commit exists to fold.** The class is not confined to U4: U2's *"Four exceptions"* list has now been found incomplete twice (F3, then F5 in `wp15b_U2_REVIEW_urev3.md`), and U3's u-rev-4 repair falsified its own B7 site-table completeness claim on the day it wrote it and simultaneously stated *"U2 is at u-rev 2"* against a u-rev 3 that was already an ancestor commit and had already failed its own review (`wp15b_U3_REVIEW_urev4.md`, MAJOR A and B). **THE DIAGNOSIS, AND IT IS WHAT MAKES THIS A LAW RATHER THAN MORE CARE:** every one of those defects is a SECOND COPY of content whose FIRST copy is correct and lives somewhere else — in an ADR line, in a selection record, in another section of the same unit. A repair that restates manufactures a stale claim at the moment it lands, because the restatement is true only at the revision it is written and nothing re-reads it. Re-derivation does not fix this: u-rev 7 re-derived the copies and shipped three fresh ones, because it removed no duplication. Care does not fix it either — three sessions applied care. **WHAT R15 BINDS:** (1) every claim has exactly ONE HOME — the section, record or ADR line that owns its subject matter — and where a claim has landed in `docs/decisions.md` or in a selection record, THAT is its home and no unit may restate it; (2) every other occurrence is a POINTER that names WHERE and does not repeat WHAT; (3) **STATUS AND SUMMARY MATTER CARRIES POINTERS ONLY** — REVIEW STATUS tables, change logs, lineage tables and OPEN lists may say that a finding exists, that it is repaired and where the repair lives, and may not restate the finding's content or the repair's content; (4) it applies to all four WP-1.5b units, to `docs/experiments/WPQ_seed.md`, to `docs/experiments/section_owner_table.md` and to EVERY FUTURE DESIGN DOCUMENT in this project. **WHAT IT DOES NOT DO:** it does not forbid QUOTATION — a marked verbatim quotation carrying its source and revision is a pointer that brings its referent with it, and is the preferred instrument where the words themselves are load-bearing; it does not disturb the RECORD discipline, under which a text an architect selected from is carried unedited and is a record of what was argued rather than a claim about what is true now; and **it does not make a pointer a finding** — a reviewer may charge a restatement only where the text carries a claim, and may not charge a section reference, an ADR reference or a file reference as one. **Flips if a document produced under this law nonetheless ships a claim a landed ADR line falsifies** — at which point restatement was not the generator, the diagnosis is wrong, and this line is superseded by the round that finds it.

D-332: **ARCHITECT RULING R17, SETTLED AND STANDING — WHEN ONE ROUND REPAIRS MORE THAN ONE UNIT, THE REPAIRS LAND SERIALLY, OR EVERY CROSS-UNIT CITATION IS RE-CHECKED AT COMMIT HEAD; AND THE COMMIT STATES WHICH.** **THE GROUND IS A MEASURED INSTANCE, NOT A HAZARD:** `docs/experiments/wp15b_U3_REVIEW_urev4.md` MAJOR B found U3's u-rev-4 repair asserting, at four sites and in the row of its own REVIEW STATUS table that announced the correction, that *"**U2** is at u-rev 2"* — when U2 had reached u-rev 3 at `d85b049`, an ANCESTOR of U3's own commit `6f2dfe6`, and that u-rev 3 had already been reviewed and had already FAILED at `e1f5dc2`, also an ancestor. The repair whose entire subject was D-311's rule that *"a citation of another unit names the unit AND the u-rev cited"* violated that rule while writing it, and `grep -n "u-rev" docs/experiments/U2_node_protocol.md` at authoring time would have shown the true value. **THE CAUSE IS ORDER, NOT CARE:** a session repairing several units reads them all at the round's start and then writes them one at a time, so every citation it writes after the first landing describes a tree that no longer exists. **WHAT R17 BINDS:** (1) either the units are repaired SERIALLY — each unit's repair authored against the tree as its predecessors left it, so a citation written into unit N is current at the moment it is written and stays current because the units it cites are already final for the round — or every cross-unit citation is re-checked against HEAD immediately before the commit that carries it; (2) the commit message, or the unit's own head, states WHICH of the two was done, because a reader cannot tell them apart afterwards and the weaker one needs disclosing; (3) this composes with D-311 and does not replace it — R17 is about WHEN the citation is checked, D-311 about WHAT it must name. **THIS ROUND WAS SERIAL AND IS RECORDED AS SUCH:** U2 to u-rev 4 at `7dfd047`, then U3 to u-rev 5 at `7473a6f` citing U2's landed state, then U4 last, citing both. **AND R17 IS NOT THE WHOLE ANSWER, WHICH IS WHY IT IS NOT THE ONLY LINE THIS ROUND LANDS:** serialising removes the ordering defect and leaves the RESTATEMENT that makes ordering matter — a live claim about another document's present state, held in a second document that nothing re-reads. D-331 is the line that addresses that, and U3's u-rev 5 answers MAJOR B by changing the citation FORM to `(u-rev N, landed <sha>)`, a historical fact that cannot go stale, rather than only by correcting four values. **WHAT THIS LINE DOES NOT DO:** it does not require a round to repair units in dependency order — the citation graph among the WP-1.5b units is not a DAG and no such order need exist; serial means *one at a time, each authored after the last has landed*, in any order the session picks. **Flips if a serial round nonetheless ships a cross-unit citation that was false when written** — at which point ordering was not the cause, and this line is superseded by the round that finds it.

D-333: **ARCHITECT RULING R18, SETTLED — N-E'S SELECTION STANDS ON THE REGISTERED LADDER, AND ITS ONE RECORDED RESIDUAL IS NOT DISCHARGED BUT IS RULED NOT TO REOPEN THE ROUND.** D-329 selected N-E on axis A of MATRIX M4 and recorded, as its own residual, that **the strongest surviving attack against N-E is ASSEMBLED AND NOT QUOTED**: the fourth round's fresh-context DECISION-RED-TEAM (`docs/experiments/matrix_M4_axisA_REDTEAM.md`, at `7e0a328`) was dispatched to break **N-Q**, it killed N-Q — the matrix's own recommendation — and it **recommended N-E without ever being asked to break it**. No fresh context has been asked to break N-E since. **R18 RULES THAT THIS DOES NOT REOPEN THE SELECTION, AND STATES THE GROUND RATHER THAN ASSUMING IT.** (1) **The matrix law is satisfied for the FIELD, which is what it binds:** a matrix was authored (`matrix_M4_axisA_round4.md` at `7866bcf`, field {N-E, N-M, N-Q}, authored under the D-328 split with no MEASURED cell written by its author) and attacked before selection, and D-329 claims no more than that. The law requires the field to be attacked; it does not require a separate round per surviving row, and no reading of this project's text has ever required one. (2) **The selection was taken at a REGISTERED LADDER RUNG, not on the attack's silence.** N-M was eliminated before the ladder ran, on registered ground — `docs/experiments/wp15b_sprt_prereg.md` §7A.2 registers `--config configs/gate_v0.toml` and N-M refuses it at exit 1. Rung (a) was SILENT across the whole field. The selection was taken at **rung (b)**, on the comparison recorded in `docs/experiments/matrix_M4_axisA_selection.md`: N-E **22** added lines of which **7** CODE, against N-Q's **32** of which **12**, both owing the same 4 whole-path guard lines and N-Q owing 5 containment lines on top, with N-E owing an item-10 driving test for 2 refusal classes against N-Q's 5 classes plus an unpinned normalisation. Every count was produced by a separate measurement agent under D-328 and **independently re-derived by the red team, which reproduced all twelve cells of that table exactly** — so the ground the selection rests on is the one part of the round that has been attacked hardest. Rung (c) was not reached; the selection is not arbitrary and is not recorded as such. (3) **The unquoted attack is a WEAKER record, and it is recorded as weaker rather than repaired by argument.** D-329 already says the Process section's strongest-surviving-attack requirement is met by an assembled paragraph, which is weaker than a quoted one. R18 does not upgrade it. **WHAT R18 DOES NOT DO:** it does not certify N-E sound; it does not discharge the four conditions riding with the selection, which remain unpaid and bind IMPL; it does not close the residual the assembled paragraph itself names — that **N-E bounds the admissible set nowhere**, so a record may name a document outside the repository that no other reader can obtain, its provenance resting on caller discipline plus a digest of bytes nobody else holds, and the round MEASURED that N-Q does not fix this either (a gitignored `configs/*.bin` passes containment into the invariant block at exit 0). That weakness is left where it was, by both rows, and is OPEN. **FLIPS IF N-E's IMPLEMENTATION DEBT MATERIALLY EXCEEDS THE 22/7 GROUND THE SELECTION WAS TAKEN ON** — that is, if the shipped `--config` seam plus its whole-path guard plus its item-10 driving tests land materially above 22 added lines and 7 CODE lines, at which point rung (b)'s comparison was taken against an estimate the implementation falsified, the ladder's answer is no longer known to be N-E's, and **M4's axis A REOPENS as a two-row comparison between N-E as built and N-Q**, with this line superseded by the round that runs it. It flips independently if a fresh-context DECISION-RED-TEAM is ever dispatched against N-E in its own right and breaks it.

D-334: **MICRO-MATRIX U4-R IS STOPPED AFTER TWO AUTHORED REVISIONS AND TWO FRESH-CONTEXT DECISION-RED-TEAMS, WITH NO SELECTION TAKEN AND NO ROW SELECTABLE — AND THE REASON THE STOP IS RECORDED RATHER THAN A THIRD REVISION AUTHORED IS THAT THE PROJECT EXECUTED THE NULL ROW WHILE THE MATRIX WAS OUT FOR ATTACK.** The matrix asked what to do about U4's restatement surface, on the ground of `docs/experiments/wp15b_U4_REVIEW_urev7.md` (FAIL, 0 BLOCKING / 4 MAJOR / 4 MINOR) and its reviewer's determination that the trigger for an architect restructure of U4's status matter was met. **REVISION 1** (`docs/experiments/matrix_U4R_restructure.md` at `4d84694`, with its stakeless measurer's log beside it) was attacked at `docs/experiments/matrix_U4R_REDTEAM.md` (`53c0c0b`): **6 KILL, 8 MAJOR, 11 MINOR** — the recommended row FELL because 382 of the 638 lines it was priced against are U4's own `RECORD OF THE EARLIER STATES`, which exist nowhere else in the tree and which this log protects by name, so the option had two horns and both were fatal; its ranking ground read the duplication measurement backwards (68 % of the registered token surface is OUTSIDE the fold spans, D-320's twenty occurrences 100 % outside); and the field was ranked by SIZE, which `docs/experiments/restructure_selection_15b.md` F2 had already MEASURED false in this same work package. **REVISION 2** (`matrix_U4R_restructure_rev2.md` at `97aa4d6`) authored the two rows round 1 named as missing and re-ranked the field by FINDINGS REACHED. It was attacked at `docs/experiments/matrix_U4R_REDTEAM_round2.md` (`1e70f81`): **6 KILL, 10 MAJOR, 11 MINOR**, verdict *"NO SELECTION MAY BE TAKEN FROM THIS FIELD, AND NO ROW IN IT IS SELECTABLE."* **THE DECISIVE FINDING IS NOT ABOUT ANY ROW.** While round 2's attack ran, `d328d1d` and `78b4876` repaired all eight findings the new cost column scores, in place, and `b9f4aea` rewrote U4's REVIEW STATUS block to pointers — **which is the substance of the recommended row's second half — inside the unit, without extraction, without a companion file, without a matrix and without a selection.** So the field no longer describes the document it governs: its denominator is empty, and the row it calls *"dead as a whole-round answer"* is the row the project took. **WHAT THIS LINE DOES:** it stops M-U4R with no selection; it records that U4's eight findings are DISCHARGED by repair at u-rev 8 and that the restructure question is therefore SEPARATED from them; and it forbids citing either revision's recommendation as adopted. **THE STRONGEST SURVIVING ATTACK, QUOTED NOT ASSEMBLED, against the row that survives wounded — (a), the U4-Z pointer index:** *"Option (a) is scoped to the region measured to hold every MAJOR the review found in the unit's body, and it is the only row of two fields whose reach survives being re-checked — but 'reached' here means the paragraph is deleted rather than the claim corrected, which scores identically to a repair the matrix says is not what the selection is about; its own flip clause has fired at least once with no stated way to tell whether it has fired again; and its scope is drawn around the two surfaces this round's findings happened to land on, while the same class has been recorded in the head block, the change log, the lineage table, §9's closing paragraph, U4-T, U4-M and §8.7 across the unit's three failed reviews."* **AND AGAINST THE NULL ROW, which is what the project actually did:** *"The null row is the only row in the field that scores full marks on the field's own ranking column — eight of eight — and it is excluded by a criterion that column does not measure, so what the exclusion convicts is the column and not the row; … and while the matrix waited for its attack the project repaired all eight findings in place and shipped u-rev 8, so the row the field calls dead is the row the field's own subject actually took, at a cost of a hundred and thirty-six further lines and no matrix at all."* **WHAT IT DOES NOT DO:** it does not answer `docs/experiments/section_owner_table.md` §11's question, which is now posed on a LARGER U4 than before — the repairs are net additive because each discloses what it replaced — and it does not license a restructure without a matrix. **A REVISION 3, IF ONE IS AUTHORED, IS RE-GROUNDED ON THE u-rev 8 REVIEW AND NOT ON `wp15b_U4_REVIEW_urev7.md`**, and round 2's report enumerates six things it must contain, of which two are rows no field has yet carried: round 1's `(e)` as round 1 actually wrote it, and **the DERIVED-ENUMERATION row on the landed `7dfd047` precedent — a rule plus a derived command replacing every hand-held enumeration and completeness universal in the unit, which round 2 measured to be the only candidate whose prevention claim is a mechanism rather than an assertion.** Flips when a revision 3 is authored and attacked, or when an architect selects `(a)` on grounds that do not come from either fallen field.

D-335: **D-331's FLIP CLAUSE HAS FIRED, ON THE ROUND THAT LANDED IT, AND THE DIAGNOSIS IS RECORDED AS INCOMPLETE RATHER THAN WITHDRAWN. WHAT SUPERSEDES IT IS THE ARCHITECT'S AND IS NOT WRITTEN HERE.** D-331 (R15) says: *"Flips if a document produced under this law nonetheless ships a claim a landed ADR line falsifies — at which point restatement was not the generator, the diagnosis is wrong, and this line is superseded by the round that finds it."* **THE ROUND THAT FINDS IT IS `docs/experiments/wp15b_U4_REVIEW_urev8.md`** (REVIEW-design, fresh context, against `a2b50bf` — FAIL, 1 BLOCKING / 7 MAJOR / 7 MINOR), and it fires the clause twice. **(i)** U4's head change log at u-rev 8 reads *"`D-329`'s relative-base residual"* — D-329 records no such residual, the selection record does (`matrix_M4_axisA_selection.md` condition 4), and **the same round had already repaired that exact misattribution 1845 lines below**: `78b4876` fixed it in U4-Z, and `b9f4aea`, a LATER COMMIT OF THE SAME ROUND, re-authored it in the head. **(ii)** U4-Z asserts that D-331 *"does not reach"* and *"is silent about"* the self-completeness class — falsified by D-331's own ground section, which names `wp15b_U3_REVIEW_urev4.md` MAJOR A and MAJOR B by citation as instances the law is built on. The same false claim was made and charged one round earlier in the sibling unit (`wp15b_U3_REVIEW_urev6.md`, MAJOR E). **WHY "INCOMPLETE" AND NOT "WRONG", stated as an argument the architect can reject:** instance (i) IS a restatement, and it is at the one surface D-331 clause (3) names by name — status and summary matter, which *"may not restate the finding's content or the repair's content"*. Had the change log POINTED, the defect could not have been re-manufactured. So the diagnosis was not falsified by (i); **the law was not followed, by the session that landed it, at the clause that would have caught it.** That is evidence about ENFORCEABILITY, which is a different finding from a wrong diagnosis, and D-331's flip clause does not distinguish them. **THREE GENERATORS ARE NOW MEASURED, AND D-331 REACHES ONE.** (1) **RESTATEMENT** — a second copy of a claim whose home is elsewhere. D-331 forbids it. (2) **SELF-COMPLETENESS** — a universal about the document's own state, asserted by its author, false in the commit that asserts it. It is at its home and restates nothing, so no clause of D-331 binds it; it has now failed U3 four consecutive rounds (MAJOR A, B, C, D) and U4 twice (u-rev 7 MAJOR 1 and MINOR 6, u-rev 8 MAJOR 3), and one attempt to answer it — replacing the universal with a DERIVED COMMAND — produced a command structurally blind to the case it was about, which is the instrument-narrowed-until-blind failure this log already carried once. **A universal laundered through a grep is still a universal.** (3) **INTRA-ROUND RE-AUTHORING** — a later commit of one round re-creating a defect an earlier commit of the same round repaired, which is (i) above and which neither of the other two names, because nothing has gone stale and nothing is a second copy at the moment of writing: the author held both texts in mind and wrote the summary from memory rather than from the repair. **THE ONE INSTRUMENT MEASURED TO FIND ANY OF THE THREE IS A FRESH-CONTEXT REVIEWER BUILDING AN INDEPENDENT CLAIM INVENTORY BY HAND** — 54 rows at u-rev 7, 61 rows at u-rev 8, 55 holding and 6 failing. No law, no structure, no grep and no matrix has found an instance. The two-round micro-matrix convened to restructure the surface the class lives on was killed twice and stopped with no selection (D-334), and its round-2 attacker recorded that the reviewer's hand inventory *"is the one thing measured to work, and it is in neither field"*. **WHAT THIS LINE DOES:** it records the firing, so no later reader finds D-331 standing with its flip unhonoured; it records the three generators and which one D-331 reaches; and it records that the repair loop is what is now under examination, four documents having each manufactured a new defect in the round that repaired the last one. **WHAT IT DOES NOT DO: it does not supersede D-331, and it writes no replacement law.** D-331 stands and still binds, because two of its three clauses are unchallenged and the third was never tested — it was not followed. A session that has just demonstrated it cannot follow the law it wrote is not the session that should write its successor, and the outstanding findings of `wp15b_U4_REVIEW_urev8.md` are collected and unrepaired for that reason under the standing rule that a re-review FAIL is collected and handed over rather than looped on. **Flips when the architect rules on the successor, or when a round under D-331 ships clean and the enforceability finding is thereby answered.**

D-336: **ARCHITECT RULING — THE LANDED-EVIDENCE RULE. EVIDENCE CITED IN A PROJECT DOCUMENT IS TRANSCRIBED FROM AN ARTEFACT THAT IS IN THE TREE, AND AN AGENT'S MESSAGE, A SCRATCHPAD FILE OR THE AUTHOR'S RECOLLECTION IS NOT ONE.** **THE INSTANCE, which is why the rule is a line and not a habit:** micro-matrix U4-R revision 1 (`4d84694`) disclosed what it called a discrepancy inside its own stakeless measurer's report, quoting a closing summary line reading *"20 live-line occurrences"* and using the mismatch as its stated ground for withholding a number. **NO SUCH LINE EXISTS IN THAT REPORT AT ANY REVISION.** The fresh-context DECISION-RED-TEAM established it (`docs/experiments/matrix_U4R_REDTEAM.md` §2): the string occurs in the repository only as the quotation attributing it, the instrument file's single summary sentence is a different one and is true, and the figure the paste actually supports — 22 — was never in doubt. The author had taken the phrase from the measuring agent's TRANSIENT COMPLETION MESSAGE and attributed it to the landed file. **The same root cause produced two further defects in the same document**, both transcriptions from that message rather than from the paste: `705` where the landed log says `707`, and three wrong distinct-section counts. **AND IT COMPOUNDED ONE ROUND LATER:** revision 2's confession of the fabrication restated round 1's conclusion that the string occurs in *"exactly one place in this repository"* — true when round 1 ran the command, false once round 1's report landed, so that the paragraph confessing a false quotation itself carried a false census of three files and four lines, one of them the sentence making the claim (`matrix_U4R_REDTEAM_round2.md` M1). **WHY THE TRANSIENT SOURCE IS THE DIAGNOSIS AND NOT CARELESSNESS:** a subagent's completion message and its landed report are two texts, the message is the one the dispatching session reads first and the only one it reads in full, and NOTHING RE-READS IT — it cannot be grepped, diffed, or cited by a reviewer, so a claim built from it is unfalsifiable at the moment it is written and false-by-drift forever after. **WHAT THIS RULE BINDS:** (1) a cited number, quotation or command output is transcribed from a FILE IN THE TREE, and the citation names that file — and names its revision wherever the cited text can move; (2) **a quotation attributed to a document must appear in that document, and the author greps for it before citing it**; (3) an agent's completion message, a subagent's summary, a scratchpad path and the author's memory of any of them are NOT citable, which is also why this project lands its review reports in-tree rather than leaving them at session-scoped paths; (4) **inside a landed file, a SUMMARY LINE IS NOT THE MEASUREMENT — the pasted output is**, and where the two disagree the paste governs and the disagreement is a finding against the summary; (5) it binds the AUTHOR, and not a reviewer or a red team, whose whole job is to re-run a command against the author's text and who may cite whatever they ran. **WHAT IT DOES NOT DO:** it does not forbid summarising, paraphrasing or abbreviating — it forbids attributing a summary to a source that does not contain it; and it does not require a citation to carry its revision where the cited text cannot move (an ADR line is append-only, a commit is immutable). **Flips if a document written under this rule nonetheless ships a fabricated or mis-attributed citation**, at which point the transient-source diagnosis is wrong, the defect is something else, and this line is superseded by the round that finds it.

D-337: **ARCHITECT RULING — THE FROZEN-MATRIX RULE. THE SUBJECT A MATRIX GOVERNS IS FROZEN FROM THE REVISION THE MATRIX LANDS AT UNTIL ITS DECISION-RED-TEAM HAS REPORTED AND THE SELECTION OR STOP IS RECORDED. A CHANGE TO THE SUBJECT INSIDE THAT WINDOW VOIDS THE ROUND — the matrix is WITHDRAWN and re-authored against the new state, never silently carried.** **THE INSTANCE IS D-334's, and it is the reason that line records a stop rather than a selection:** micro-matrix U4-R revision 2 landed at `97aa4d6` and was dispatched against `docs/experiments/U4_soundness_instrument.md`. While its attack ran, five commits of the same session — `d328d1d`, `75ae04e`, `78b4876`, `b9f4aea`, `823004a` — repaired **all eight findings the matrix's cost column scores**, took the unit to u-rev 8, and rewrote its REVIEW STATUS block to pointers, **which was the recommended row's own second half, achieved in place without extraction, companion file, matrix or selection.** The attacker's verdict (`matrix_U4R_REDTEAM_round2.md`): *"THE FIELD NO LONGER DESCRIBES THE DOCUMENT IT GOVERNS … a selection taken from this field now would be taken against a state that does not exist, on a column whose denominator is empty"*, and *"the row the field calls dead is the row the field's own subject actually took."* **WHY THIS IS A VOID AND NOT A CAVEAT.** A matrix is a COMPARISON AGAINST A STATE: its cost cells, its failure modes and its ranking column all quantify over the subject as it stood. Move the subject and the cells are not merely stale — the comparison becomes unanswerable, and no session can afterwards separate the findings that were about the old state from the findings that survive, because the attacker was reading one document and the selector would be acting on another. The existing convention that a reviewer states the subject's revision and whether it still matches HEAD is what MAKES this checkable; **this rule says what a mismatch in the SUBJECT means, which that convention left open.** **WHAT IT BINDS:** (1) the freeze runs from the matrix's landing SHA to the recorded selection or stop, and the window belongs to the MATRIX, not to the session; (2) the freeze covers **the subject the matrix governs**, not the tree — unrelated work, sibling units, `tools/`, ADR lines and the reviews of other documents are unaffected, and this round's U2, U3 and Track C work would have been untouched by it; (3) **if the subject MUST change inside the window** — a falsehood found in it, a red gate, a landed ADR line it contradicts — **the change is made and the MATRIX IS WITHDRAWN**, explicitly, in the same commit set; the subject is never held hostage to a matrix; (4) a red team whose subject moved reports **VOID on that ground** and is not asked to reconstruct which of its findings survive. **WHAT IT DOES NOT DO:** it does not make a void round's findings worthless — round 2's findings about the matrix's OWN reasoning stand, are landed, and are what D-334 rests on; and **it does not say the repairs in the instance were wrong.** They were owed, they discharged eight real findings, and they were the right act; what was wrong was leaving a matrix standing over a subject they were changing, when withdrawing it cost nothing and would have said so on the record. **Flips if a round conducted under a proper freeze nonetheless yields a field no selection can be taken from**, at which point subject drift was not what voided the instance, and this line is superseded by the round that finds it.

D-338: **MATRIX META-1 IS STOPPED AFTER ONE AUTHORED REVISION AND ONE FRESH-CONTEXT DECISION-RED-TEAM, WITH NO SELECTION TAKEN AND NO ROW SELECTABLE. THE RECOMMENDED ROW FALLS ON FIVE KILLS, AND D-337's FREEZE ON THE SIX SUBJECT DOCUMENTS ENDS AT THIS LINE.** The matrix (`docs/experiments/matrix_META1_successor_R15.md`, landed VERBATIM at `b683d48`; dispatch at `1f834ca`) asked what succeeds R15/D-331 as the law governing the drift class, and recommended **D = META-BAN + review contract**. It was attacked at `docs/experiments/matrix_META1_REDTEAM.md`, landed at `1f1f6ad`: **5 KILL, 11 MAJOR, 4 MINOR**, verdict *"NO SELECTION MAY BE TAKEN FROM THIS FIELD. NO ROW IN IT IS SELECTABLE."* **THE FREEZE HELD** — `git diff b683d48..HEAD` over the six subject documents was empty for the whole window, the attacker verified it and rejected the void as RJ1, so this stop is recorded on a field that still described its subject, which is what D-334's could not claim. **THE FIVE KILLS.** (K1) **E3 IS FALSE** — the premise the recommendation's own first clause rests on. Eleven recorded restatement instances sit in NORMATIVE sections (U3 §6.1, §6.2, §6.3, §6.5, §10, U3-M item 4; U2 §5.3; U4 §8.4), they are enumerated in a landed table inside the matrix's own frozen subject at `U3_tier_t.md:886-898`, they are live at HEAD, and A/D's deletion strip reaches **none** of them. (K2) **D's CITATION GATE IS VACUOUS** — MEASURED over the six frozen documents: 576 `D-nnn` references, 67 distinct keys, **zero dangling**. Reviews already spend zero rows on reference existence. The recorded defect is MISATTRIBUTION and existence-checking is invariant under it: `D-329` and `D-331` both resolve and are both misdescribed, which is CLAUDE.md's named failure — a criterion resting on a property the defect class PRESERVES. (K3) **FLIP CLAUSE 2 HAD ALREADY FIRED WHEN THE MATRIX WAS AUTHORED**, since the normative-text instances of K1 predate it; that is `restructure_selection_15b.md` F6's class, scored KILL in this same work package. (K4) **E1's CITED SOURCE IS NOT IN THE TREE** — see D-339. (K5) **REGISTERED CONDITION 1 IS NOT EXECUTABLE**: deletion-only, applied literally to line 3 of each of the six documents, removes the carve marker and turns a CI gate red. **PER-OPTION SURVIVAL, AS RECORDED:** **A FALLS** (its whole ground is E3 and E5, both false; its rule reddens a gate; and M8 measures the strip to be indeterminate — between 265 and 1047 lines of U4 depending on which reading of "status block" is taken). **D FALLS** on all five KILLs plus M8 and M11. **B INVENTORY SURVIVES WOUNDED** — selectable only paired with a check on the inventory's own summary, because both landed inventories ship a headline count of their own table that their own table falsifies. **C RE-SCOPE SURVIVES WOUNDED AND IS UNDERRATED** — its rot argument is answered in-tree by the strike-through convention this project has executed three times. **THE NULL ROW IS RESURRECTED AND SURVIVES WOUNDED** — its death certificate was E6, and E6 is demoted to direction-only by D-341. **THE DOMINANT MISSING ROW IS C-prime, WAIVE-AND-MARK**, and it is recorded here as the row a revision 2 owes first: keep every document; answer every meta finding by striking the sentence through and appending a fixed `WITHDRAWN AS FALSE AT u-rev N` token, never by rewording and never by re-deriving; reviews stay at full scope. **It is not hypothetical — the project has executed it three times inside U4's own REVIEW STATUS tables and the fresh reviewer of u-rev 8 prescribes it by name as the fix for MAJOR 5.** Against D's own grounds it is deletion-shaped, removes the false claim, needs no strip session, no citation gate, no SHELL_CHECKLIST round and no re-review of four rewritten documents, preserves the record a future reader needs, and is incremental so it cannot manufacture a mid-strip drift across four units at once. **The one thing C-prime does not do is shrink U4, and E4 — 1886 to 2105, +219, against the 1975-line document the carve replaced — is the only E-item that reproduces to the digit. That is the honest argument for D over C-prime, and the matrix does not make it.** **FOUR FURTHER MISSING ROWS** stand recorded against a revision 2: R2 review-contract-only with findings batched and nothing authored in-round, R3 derived-enumeration on the landed `7dfd047` precedent (which D-334 already owed and which round 2 MEASURED to be the only candidate whose prevention claim is a mechanism rather than an assertion), R4 the self-state gate (**MEASURED: two unrecorded live instances in six documents in under a second, against the citation gate's zero** — landed as gate 15 by this session), and R5 retire-don't-edit for `WPQ_seed.md`, which the owner table's own §11 marks not reviewable. **THE STRONGEST SURVIVING ATTACK, QUOTED NOT ASSEMBLED, against C, which is the row a revision 2 is most likely to take:** *"C's failure mode is stated against the wrong version of C. Waiving a false sentence silently does rot, and the U1 lesson is real — a falsehood rode five documents and nine rounds because nothing marked it. But this project has already executed the marked form three times inside U4's own REVIEW STATUS tables, and the fresh reviewer of u-rev 8 prescribes it by name as the fix for MAJOR 5: strike the sentence, state the disposition, replace it with nothing. What survives against C is narrower and harder: marking is still an edit, every edit is an occasion for generator three, and C shrinks nothing — U4 stays at 2105 lines against a property this project has recorded three times as having no instrument, so C answers the falsehoods and leaves the only question the matrix's own E4 measures."* **WHAT THIS LINE DOES:** it stops META-1 with no selection; it forbids citing D or A as adopted or as leaning; it records C-prime and R2-R5 as the rows a revision 2 owes; and **it ENDS D-337's freeze on `U1_gate_supersession.md`, `U2_node_protocol.md`, `U3_tier_t.md`, `U4_soundness_instrument.md`, `WPQ_seed.md` and `section_owner_table.md`**, which are editable from this line forward. **WHAT IT DOES NOT DO:** it authors no successor law to D-331, which stands and still binds per D-335; it does not answer `section_owner_table.md` §11's size question; and it does not license a restructure without a matrix. Flips when a revision 2 is authored and attacked, or when an architect selects C-prime or B on grounds that do not come from this fallen field.

D-339: **D-336's FLIP CLAUSE FIRED ON THE ROUND THAT LANDED D-336. THE INSTANCE IS RECORDED; THE DIAGNOSIS IS NOT WITHDRAWN; AND THIS IS THE THIRD CONSECUTIVE ARCHITECT LINE IN THIS WORK PACKAGE TO FLIP ON THE ROUND THAT LANDED OR FIRST GOVERNED IT.** D-336's clause: *"Flips if a document written under this rule nonetheless ships a fabricated or mis-attributed citation."* **THE INSTANCE:** matrix META-1's **E1** — the taxonomy the entire matrix is built on — cites *"Source: closure session report, D-335."* **NO FILE NAMED OR DESCRIBABLE AS A CLOSURE SESSION REPORT EXISTS, AND NONE EVER DID.** The fresh-context DECISION-RED-TEAM established it as K4 (`matrix_META1_REDTEAM.md`, `1f1f6ad`): `ls docs/experiments/ | grep -i clos` is empty, and the three `grep -rn "closure session"` hits across `docs/` belong to WP-1.5a and the T-bucket, a different work package. **THIS SESSION EXTENDED THE CHECK TO ALL OF HISTORY AND IT IS WORSE THAN NOT-IN-THE-TREE: `git log --all --diff-filter=A` shows the file was never added at any revision.** D-335 is real and in the tree and carries the taxonomy; the other half of the citation is the author's memory of a session, which is precisely what D-336 clause (3) forbids. **THE MATRIX'S REGISTERED CONDITION 2 BINDS D-336 BY NAME, AND D-336 LANDED IN THE SAME COMMIT AS THE MATRIX (`b683d48`)**, so this is a document written under the rule, citing the rule, breaking the rule, in the rule's own commit. **A SECOND UNRECOVERABLE CITATION IS RECORDED HERE, FOUND BY THE SAME SWEEP:** `dispatch_prereg_rev4_review.md`, cited at `restructure_selection_15b.md:87` as the held dispatch governing a first review, **was also never added at any revision**. MEASURED, the sweep over every `.md` citation in `docs/decisions.md` and every matrix resolved 77 distinct paths: these two are the only ones absent from both the tree and all of history. The rest resolve and are recorded so no later reader re-derives them — `SCHEMA.md`, `README.md` and `data-flow.md` are the external platform corpus and hexo-bridge and are correctly out-of-tree; `U4_STATE.md` is a proposed artefact of a matrix row that was never selected (D-334) and is hypothetical by construction; `wp15b_design.md` is the pre-carve document the carve deleted and is retrievable at `6feb40a`, which its citers name. **BOTH MISSING SOURCES ARE RULED UNRECOVERABLE BY THE OPERATOR AND NO RECONSTRUCTION IS LANDED**, because authoring a "closure session report" now would be manufacturing the source D-336 exists to forbid — the surviving home of E1's taxonomy is D-335 and citers are re-pointed there. **WHY THE DIAGNOSIS IS NOT WITHDRAWN.** D-336's flip says the transient-source diagnosis is wrong if a document under the rule ships a bad citation. It is not wrong: E1's source **is** a transient agent message, which is exactly what the rule names. What fired is the same thing D-335 recorded of D-331 — **ENFORCEABILITY, not diagnosis.** The law was not followed, in the commit that wrote it, at the clause that would have caught it, by the session that wrote it. Three lines in a row have now done this (D-328 to D-330, D-331 to D-335, D-336 here), which makes the pattern the finding rather than any one line: **a rule authored and first exercised in the same commit is not tested by that commit, and the author is the party least able to test it.** **THE CORRECTIVE PRACTICE, RECORDED AS JUDGED AND NOT MECHANIZED:** before landing, the AUTHOR of any document runs a pre-flight over its own text — (a) every cited source is resolved to a file **at a SHA**, by running the command, not by recollection; (b) every clause the document binds by name is checked as **not already fired** against the document's own content, which is K3's class and would have caught it here; (c) every numeric cell carries **MEASURED** or **ESTIMATED**, which is D-340's class. **IT IS NOT A GATE AND THIS LINE DOES NOT PROPOSE ONE.** (a) is mechanizable and is partly what gate 15 now does for self-state; (b) and (c) are judgements about what a sentence means, and the project has three landed instances of a criterion narrowed until it was blind to the case it was written for. Flips when a rule authored in one commit is first exercised in a later one and still ships the defect it forbids, at which point the same-commit exercise is not the cause and the diagnosis is something else. **AMENDMENT: `dispatch_prereg_rev4_review.md` REMAINS UNRECOVERABLE — THAT RULING STANDS — AND IS SUPERSEDED RATHER THAN RECOVERED.** The architect re-authored the dispatch it governed, content updated for WP-1.5b's shipped D scope, and supplied it for landing; it is landed VERBATIM at `docs/experiments/dispatch_prereg_review.md` (commit `f79aa3d`), a new file under a new name, not a reconstruction of the original's lost text. The citation at `restructure_selection_15b.md:87` — "the held dispatch governing a first review" — resolves via this line to the superseding file; it does not resolve to the original, which no reconstruction is licensed to stand in for.

D-340: **A D-291-CLASS FINDING IS RECORDED AGAINST MATRIX META-1: NOT ONE CELL IN ITS OPTION TABLE OR ITS EVIDENCE BASE CARRIES A MEASURED OR ESTIMATED MARK. THE MATRIX IS DEAD BY D-338 AND THE FINDING IS RECORDED ANYWAY, SO THE CLASS COUNT STAYS HONEST.** CLAUDE.md's matrix clause: *"EVERY NUMERIC CLAIM IN THE MATRIX IS MARKED MEASURED OR ESTIMATED, and an estimate that could have been measured in seconds is a finding."* **MEASURED: zero marks across six E-items and five option rows.** Three of the six E-items are numeric — E2 (54 and 61 inventory rows), E4 (2105, +219, 1975), E6 (23, 20, 12, 15) — and E4 measures in one command while E6 took the attacker seven. Two further unmarked numbers carry load: flip clause 1's *">20 percent of unit text"*, which is invented, denominator-free and returns opposite verdicts on two defensible readings of the same text (M6); and the recommendation's *"~10 rounds"*, which is low — measured, 17 landed review reports plus 2 DECISION-RED-TEAM rounds against the U4-R micro-matrix (m4). **THE IMPLEMENTING SESSION DISCLOSED THE ABSENCE IN THE PROVENANCE COMMENT RATHER THAN REPAIRING IT, AND WAS RIGHT NOT TO REPAIR IT** — adding marks would have been editing an architect's verbatim text, which the landing existed to prevent. **BUT DISCLOSURE IS NOT THE REMEDY THE CLAUSE NAMES.** The clause is not satisfied by a note saying it is unsatisfied, and the right act was to return the matrix to its author unlanded, not to land it disclosed. **WHY THIS IS RECORDED AGAINST A DEAD FIELD.** D-291 records that this project has twice in one round shipped a matrix arguing that unmeasured claims are the failure mode while resting on one. This is the next instance, and if it is not written down the count reads two where it is three, on a class whose whole diagnostic value is the count. **WHAT THIS LINE DOES:** it records the instance; it binds a revision 2 of META-1 to carry marks on every numeric cell before dispatch; and it records that **the disclosure-instead-of-repair move is itself now a recorded pattern** — an implementing session that finds a matrix in breach returns it rather than landing it with a note. Flips if a matrix ships fully marked and its numbers are wrong anyway, at which point marking is not what the clause is buying.

D-341: **E6 IS DEMOTED TO DIRECTION-ONLY. THE CONVERGENCE CLAIM SURVIVES; THE SERIES DOES NOT; AND THE NULL ROW'S DEATH ON E6 IS VACATED.** E6 reads: *"Convergence reversed: findings 23 -> 20 -> 12 -> 15+ (U4 alone), zero PASS at close."* **THE MIDDLE TERMS RECONCILE ON NO LANDED DENOMINATOR.** The implementing session could not reconcile them at landing and said so in the provenance comment rather than changing the number; the attacker then tried **seven** denominators over the landed verdict blocks — U4 alone, U4 by blocking-plus-major, all units per round, all units by blocking-plus-major, the three units without U1, U3 and U4 together, and cumulative — and **none yields 23, 20, 12, 15** (M4). On the most natural reading, each landed report's own verdict line for U4, the series is 23 (and that report covers the WHOLE pre-carve document, not U4 alone), 11, 7, 8, 15 — which is not the stated series and does not have its shape in the middle. **AND "ZERO PASS AT CLOSE" IS FALSE OF THE CORPUS: three landed PASSes exist**, one of them `wp15b_U1_REVIEW_urev2.md` at 0 BLOCKING / 0 MAJOR / 0 MINOR, which is U1's only review outcome and is cited nowhere by U1 itself (M3, and repaired by this session's u-rev 4 head/foot fix). **WHAT SURVIVES: THE DIRECTION, AND IT SURVIVES ROBUSTLY.** On all seven denominators the tail turns back up. The last round is worse than the round before it, and that is true however the corpus is sliced, which is a stronger form of the claim than the series was — it is invariant under the choice of denominator, and the series was not. **WHAT THIS LINE DOES:** it rules that E6 may be cited for the DIRECTION and never for the numbers; it forbids any future field from excluding a row on E6's series; and **it VACATES the NULL row's death**, which the matrix rested entirely on E6 (*"Dead on the evidence; row present per law"*). NULL is resurrected and survives wounded, as D-338's survivor list records. **THIS IS THE SECOND TIME IN THIS WORK PACKAGE A NULL ROW HAS BEEN EXCLUDED ON A CRITERION THAT DID NOT MEASURE IT** — D-334 recorded the first, where the field's own subject then executed the row the field called dead. That prior is now a standing attack on any exclusion of a null row in this work package, and a field that excludes one owes the measurement in the same document. **WHAT IT DOES NOT DO:** it does not claim the process is converging. It is not — the direction reproduces seven ways, and D-335's four-documents-each-manufacturing-a-defect-in-the-round-that-repaired-the-last finding is untouched by this demotion. Flips if a denominator is found that reproduces the series, at which point E6 stands as written and only its *"zero PASS"* clause falls.

D-342: **TWO CLAIMS THIS SESSION WROTE INTO D-338 AND D-341 WERE FALSIFIED BY THE SAME SESSION'S OWN LATER WORK, AND THEY ARE CORRECTED HERE RATHER THAN EDITED. THE INSTANCE COUNT IS THREE, NOT TWO, AND THERE WAS NO u-rev 4.** The log is append-only, so a line that goes false is answered by a later line and never by a rewrite. **CORRECTION 1 — THE COUNT.** D-338 records missing row R4 as *"MEASURED: two unrecorded live instances in six documents in under a second"*, transcribing `matrix_META1_REDTEAM.md` M3. **IT IS THREE.** `U4_soundness_instrument.md` was head `u-rev 8` against foot `u-rev 7` for the whole freeze window and M3 did not report it. **THE REASON IS THE INSTRUMENT AND IT IS THE POINT:** M3's loop reads a three-line tail, and U4's closing paragraph is a single very long line sitting behind a `---` rule, so on U4 the loop printed a truncated `foot=u-rev` with no number — which its author read as noise rather than as a refusal, and which the surrounding text does not mention. Two of the other five documents wrap their closing block over several lines and the same loop happened to catch those. **A FIXED-DEPTH TAIL IS NOT A READING OF A CLOSING BLOCK**, the gate landed at `908a2f7` reads the block, and measured against `1f834ca` it refuses three documents where the loop found two. **This does not weaken M3 — it strengthens it.** M3's claim is that a STRUCTURE finds in one second what ten review rounds did not, against E2's universal that only a fresh reviewer's hand inventory reaches the class; a structure that finds three where the first spelling found two is that claim with a larger number. What it corrects is the SIZE, and the size was load-bearing in D-338's ranking of R4 against D's citation gate (three against zero, not two against zero). **CORRECTION 2 — THERE WAS NO u-rev 4, AND THE OTHER HALF OF M3 IS NOT REPAIRED.** D-341 says of U1's landed PASS that it is *"cited nowhere by U1 itself (M3, and repaired by this session's u-rev 4 head/foot fix)"*. **BOTH CLAUSES ARE FALSE.** U1's head did not move: it was and remains `u-rev 3`, and what changed at `f81706a` is the FOOT, brought up to the head. And the repair was the LABEL only — `grep -c wp15b_U1_REVIEW_urev2 docs/experiments/U1_gate_supersession.md` still returns `0` at HEAD, U1's head still reads *"THIS UNIT HAS BEEN REVIEWED, AT u-rev 1, AND FAILED"* and still says the text is unreviewed until a fresh REVIEW-design runs against u-rev 2, and **U1-A still has no row for the one PASS in this work package.** That half of M3 stands OPEN and is owed by a later round; the session was scoped to the mechanical class and did not exceed it. **WHY BOTH ARE RECORDED AND NOT QUIETLY DROPPED.** D-341's parenthetical is a claim about the document's own state, asserted by its author, false in the commit that asserts it — **D-335's generator (2), committed in the line demoting E6 for the same species of unreconciled number, by the session that had just written D-339 recording the corrective pre-flight against exactly this.** It was written before the work it describes was done and never re-checked afterwards, which is generator (3), intra-round re-authoring, in its purest form: the author held the plan in mind and wrote the ADR from the plan rather than from the tree. **THE PRE-FLIGHT D-339 RECORDS IS THEREFORE MEASURED ONCE AND FAILED ONCE, BY ITS OWN AUTHOR, IN THE SAME SESSION.** That is evidence for D-339's diagnosis and not against it — the pre-flight's clause (a) is *resolve every cited source by running the command, not by recollection*, and a forward-tense claim about work not yet done cannot be resolved by any command at the moment it is written. **SO ONE CLAUSE IS ADDED TO THE PRACTICE, JUDGED AND NOT MECHANIZED: AN ADR LINE STATES NOTHING IN THE FUTURE TENSE ABOUT THE SESSION LANDING IT.** A claim about work not yet done is unfalsifiable when written and false-by-drift if the work changes shape, which is D-336's transient-source defect with the session's own plan as the transient source. Where an ADR must be landed before the work it describes — D-338 had to land first, because it lifts D-337's freeze the work needed — the line names the work as OWED and a later line records what happened. Flips if a session adopts the no-future-tense clause and still ships a false self-claim, at which point tense is not the mechanism and the defect is something else.

D-343: **THE CARVE-MEMBERSHIP RULE IS NARROWED A SECOND TIME, FROM LINE EQUALITY TO POSITION, BECAUSE THE FIRST NARROWING WAS SCOPED TO THE SHAPE OF ONE INSTANCE AND THE NEXT RED TEAM DEFEATED IT WITHOUT TRYING.** `crates/pistol-solver/tests/wp15b_census.rs` answers *"which files did the carve produce"* from the tree by looking for `CARVE_MARKER`. **ROUND 1:** the test asked `text.contains(..)`; a DECISION-RED-TEAM pasted the constant's Rust definition into its report, the substring matched inside the pasted source line, and the pin went RED declaring two argument documents to be carved design units — a sibling unit's reviewer hit the same red gate and had to isolate it before it could report on its own subject.
